v.1: Indeed We sent it down on the Night of Ordainment.
v.2: And what will show you what is the Night of Ordainment?
v.3: The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months.
v.4: In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.
v.5: It is peaceful until the rising of the dawn.
